Thanks again for the time last week. I've attached a short proposal that sketches term options and a staging/production rollout schedule.

Key asks from our side to get this into a signed amendment by June 1: 
- Confirm required go‑live window (staging → prod) and blackout dates for data migrations.
- Confirm whether Bluefield signs the standard Private Addendum or needs a custom SLA clause (you flagged a higher‑availability ask).
- Procurement contact for the PO and billing cadence.

High level proposal in the attachment: 12‑month renewal with a 10% uplift for the reserved on‑prem nodes; if Bluefield commits to 24 months we can offer a 15% uplift credit and one month of standby capacity at no charge during the first quarter of deployment.

I copied Connor and Laura from Ops and Deploy respectively so we can coordinate the schedule. If it’s helpful, we can lock a 30‑minute timeline call next week to align on dates — slot suggestions below.
